Local en venta. Rentabilidad NETA anual 5%.

inv.desc_en:
Local for sale. Annual NET profitability 5%.

Contract signed in July 2025. Mandatory compliance: July 1, 2018

Activity: restaurant (Take away hamburger restaurant).

Located in the heart of the busy La Latina neighborhood.

Local with excellent visibility, due to the large chamfered facade, and great circulation of public, due to its unbeatable location, very close to Plaza de la Cebada.

Surface area of 73 useful m² broken down into:
-Sales room of 33 m² on the ground floor
-Basement of 40 m²

Directly property. Intermediation fees with Real Estate Agents are accepted.

See plans for number of rooms and toilets.

NOTE: This announcement is not binding, may contain errors, is shown for informational purposes and not contractual. The text offered, together with photos and sketches of the property, is intended for use as an informative instrument. It has no legal validity.
